method: Run from the worktree root in this order. First, addendum: the signed IB-pr-595 transplant files for 49financial (committed under its deliverables folder) were read and their sha256 checked against its record; holdings_snapshot.py was three-way merged with git merge-file (ours the signed transplant, base the blob of commit e2700915d2, theirs the blob of commit 1ff5e87e40, which is HEAD's file) and the merge was checked: every ABSENT-AT-SOURCE-D span stripped equals the signed transplant byte for byte, the spans equal HEAD's spans, the one-date bypass is absent; publication.py was copied unchanged from the signed transplant; both candidate files were committed in the addendum folder. Second, the firm phase: in the minting pin worktree (outside the repository, sparse checkout disabled there alone) the two candidate files were copied in, the bundle was built twice by the minting pin's safe_deploy_core build_bundle_payload (BUILD ONLY, no upload function called), the live bundle was read with s3api head-object and get-object (read only) and compared member by member, and six offline test files were copied from HEAD and run with pytest (the one-date bypass test was not run). Third, the assemble phase wrote the record. Nothing was uploaded, minted, deployed, signed or written to AWS.
notes: Facts and their basis: the candidate holdings_snapshot.py is the signed IB-pr-595 transplant plus 59 D-span lines merged with 0 conflicts (59 lines added, 0 removed); HEAD's file blob equals the blob of commit 1ff5e87e40 (True).

Measured on the minting pin with the two candidate files in place: 46 closure members, 2 changed against the live bundle (the two overlay members only), 44 equal; the two builds were identical in members (True) and in tar bytes (True).

Not read and not run: no S3 object was written, no Lambda invoked, no publish or mint function called, no sign-in made, no vendor contacted; the live version identifier is compared as a boolean and is not written. The one-date bypass test was not copied or run because it tests the bypass that is not shipped.

Sparse directories: the base worktree gained data/assets/scripts/gold/investor_reporting/ only (local, never committed); the minting pin is a full detached checkout outside the repository, so no import-chain directory was added.
Offline tests: six files copied from HEAD into the pin tree (tests are not bundle members) and run with pytest; passed=99 failed=0 (pytest rc=0); any failing test is named in a row, not edited away.
